messages.subject: RE: Whitford — our counter (marked-up SA attached)
messages.plaintextBody:
Mr Vesey,

Thank you for the mark-up. Our client is prepared to move to £185,000 ex gratia, a £750+VAT fees contribution, and payment within 14 days. We accept your reference amendments (CEO-signed, ten working days). We are not able to reach £190,000. On that basis we have instructions to settle and will turn the agreement to a clean execution version.

Please confirm your client's acceptance.

Sarah Whitfield

--
Sarah Whitfield

22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
sarah.whitfield@whitfieldcarter.com
Confidential and may be legally privileged.
